thought.title: GG_CHUNK 64→512 + x2备份缓冲区 → 3.13x加速
thought.description: 将GG_CHUNK从64扩大到512以减少向量化循环迭代次数8倍，添加wX2_备份缓冲区避免GELU tanh计算中x2重载，增加bfloat16支持，将TILE_N_MAX设为65536使全shape走全行路径
thought.reason: baseline GG_CHUNK=64导致循环迭代次数过多(每行64次chunk循环)，512可减少到每行4-8次迭代，显著减少指令发射开销并提升向量单元利用率。x2Wk在x2^3计算中被覆写，需要额外wX2_缓冲区保存副本以供后续x2*(1+tanh)使用
thought.target_bottleneck: vectorization chunk too small (GG_CHUNK=64), excessive loop overhead

runtime.dsl_before: GG_CHUNK=64, fp16 only, single work buffer set
runtime.dsl_after: GG_CHUNK=512, TILE_N_MAX=65536, wX2_ backup buffer, bf16 support
